title: Boxes: export a boxed picture to PSD (text layers + SAM3 cut-outs)
description: Fabio 2026-10-23: export a picture laid out with Create boxes (MPI-1253) to a layered PSD. Nobody else exports boxes to PSD (ComfyUI layout nodes do not) - a differentiator. Every TEXT box becomes a live Photoshop text layer holding its words (the quoted head of the box desc), placed at the box with the right orientation (vertical lettering stays vertical); size from the box, it need not be exact - Photoshop's own text boxes take it from there. Everything that is NOT text is cut out with SAM3 inside its box onto its own transparent layer, named after the box. Open: a clean background plate (text and subjects inpainted out) so nothing shows twice; fitting the boxes to the RESULT first (snapBoxes) since the model drifts from them; orientation is not stored on a box today. Library: ag-psd (pure JS, MIT, not installed). The PSD also opens in Photopea and GIMP.
